char_kael_74000bce.name: the elder spear-hunter
char_kael_74000bce.description: 45-year-old Late Pleistocene East African hunter, weathered dark skin dusted with grey volcanic ash and red ochre, coarse braided hair, cracked antelope-hide cloak over muscular shoulders, holding a fire-hardened wooden spear

costumes.default: Cracked antelope-hide cloak fastened with bone pin, red ochre stripe across cheekbone

char_sena_74000bce.name: the master stone artisan and inventor
char_sena_74000bce.description: 26-year-old Late Pleistocene East African woman artisan, intense dark eyes reflecting amber firelight, charcoal-stained fingers, woven leather work apron, necklace of perforated Nassarius shells and an obsidian pendant

costumes.default: Leather work apron, perforated shell and obsidian necklace, bone pressure-flaker at belt

char_thar_74000bce.name: the leader
char_thar_74000bce.description: 35-year-old Late Pleistocene hunter from the southern Rift Valley, tall gaunt frame, ash-caked leather wraps, carrying geometric-engraved ostrich eggshell water flasks in knotted hide netting across his chest

costumes.default: Ash-caked leather shoulder wraps, net of engraved ostrich-eggshell water containers
